title: Token refresh classification: follow-ups from the RF-218 final review
acceptance: A test pins what refreshFailure answers when a 429 or 5xx token response carries invalid_grant, and the order of the dead-grant and status checks is deliberate.
OpenAPI describes the 409 as an invalid_grant refusal and the playback-token 502 as including a refused client, matching api.md; the iOS snapshot refresh is named if the spec changes.
The SoundCloud refresh path has an integration test, and the record states what SoundCloud's token endpoint answers for a revoked grant, checked against the provider.
nextAction: Non-blocking findings from the #767 final review and the RF-218 agent's report (2026-11-13). Provider code and OpenAPI are owner-gated. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner sets Ready.

evidence.summary: Final review on 4e53977: no significant findings. Non-blocking: isDeadGrant is checked before the status in refresh-failure.ts with no test for the ordering; generate-openapi.ts 409 wording drifts from api.md and the playback-token 502 description omits a refused client; a provider that signals a dead grant with another code now gives a 502 with no Reconnect, not verified against real Spotify or SoundCloud.
